description: This file defines functions related to sensor initialization and analog switch reading within an engine control system. It includes sensor initialization routines and a method to determine the air conditioning toggle status based on ADC voltage levels.

methods.name: initSensors
methods.description: Initializes various sensors including thermistors, map decoder, and flex fuel sensor.

methods.name: getAcToggle
methods.description: Determines whether the A/C is toggled on by reading the voltage of the A/C switch ADC input and comparing it to a threshold.
